snippet.title: Devastator Launch Trailer - Sectors Gameplay
snippet.description:
Devastator is a retro-modern twin-stick shooter, and is now available on Switch, Playstation, Xbox, and Steam!  Intense but deep gameplay across 3 unique modes, all running at 4k 120FPS (on the latest consoles/PC).

Trailer showcases the first 10 waves of Sectors Mode.  Quadrants and Cycles modes will get their own videos soon.

Links:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10002443
https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/devastator-switch/
https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/devastator/9pggcglhc0vs
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1452280/Devastator/

Devastator is developed by Radiangames and published by 2Awesome Studio.
